info.name: GovtPrep Backend API
info.description: Full API surface for the GovtPrep backend, including the updated TestSeries (importantDates, negativeMarking, negativeMarksPerQuestion, marksPerQuestion, real image upload) and Test (sections, mandatory testSeries) endpoints.

request.description: multipart/form-data — image/notificationPdf/infoPdf are each independent real file uploads. importantDates must be a JSON-stringified string; every value is an exact { from, to } date (a single day sets from === to) — free-text dates like "July 2025" are rejected with a 400. negativeMarking/negativeMarksPerQuestion/marksPerQuestion are inherited by every Test created under this series.

formdata.value: SSC CGL is conducted to recruit candidates for various Group B and C posts.

request.description: multipart/form-data. Omit any of image/notificationPdf/infoPdf to keep the existing one — each is independent. All fields optional.

testSeries is now required — every test must belong to a series. sections carries the per-subject exam-pattern breakdown and must have at least one entry. duration is always computed server-side as the sum of every section's duration (any duration sent here is ignored) — do not send it. totalQuestions/totalMarks are left alone here too; they're auto-calculated from actual Question documents as they're added (see Questions (Admin) > Create Question).
Sending sections recomputes duration as the sum of the new sections. Omitting sections leaves duration untouched.
CSV columns: test, questionText, option1, option2, option3, option4, correctAnswer(1-based), marks, explanation, order
